nodes.label: XPCS Data Optimization
nodes.rationale: Subsampling is off by default and must be explicitly requested. Every invocation is logged to maintain data integrity per project rules.

nodes.label: XPCS Data Loader
nodes.rationale: Implements half-matrix reconstruction and diagonal correction to handle APS detector shot-noise artifacts, ensuring homodyne compatibility.

nodes.label: Parameter Manager
nodes.rationale: Uses a frozen snapshot of initial values to ensure each phi-angle optimization starts from config values regardless of previous fit mutations.

nodes.label: CMC Subsystem
nodes.rationale: CPU-optimized Bayesian posterior inference for the heterodyne 14-parameter model using NumPyro NUTS. Second stage of pipeline, warm-started from NLSQ. Implements data sharding, per-shard NUTS, and precision-weighted consensus combination (Scott et al. 2016).

nodes.label: NumPyro Model
nodes.rationale: Six model constructors serve different per-angle scaling modes and parameterization strategies. Physics dispatch: meshgrid path (jax_backend.py) when shard_grid is None, element-wise path (physics_cmc.py) when shard_grid provided to avoid O(N^2) allocation per leapfrog step.

nodes.label: Z-Space Reparameterization
nodes.rationale: Power-law pairs (D0, alpha) form banana-shaped posteriors because D0*t^alpha is approximately constant at the data's characteristic time scale. NUTS struggles to explore this geometry. Reparameterization: log_D_at_tref = log(D0) + alpha*log(t_ref), where t_ref = sqrt(dt*t_max). At t_ref the log product is well-constrained, making the posterior approximately elliptical and NUTS-friendly.

nodes.label: smooth_bound()
nodes.rationale: Replaces jnp.clip() (zero gradient at bounds) with tanh-based smooth bounding: smooth_bound(raw, low, high) = mid + half*tanh((raw-mid)/half). Maps (-inf,+inf)->(low,high) with nonzero gradient everywhere, preventing NUTS mass matrix adaptation from stalling at boundaries.

nodes.label: consensus_mc()
nodes.rationale: Precision-matrix weighted posterior combination: Lambda_combined = sum_k Lambda_k, mu_combined = Lambda_combined^-1 sum_k Lambda_k mu_k. Exact when sub-posteriors are Gaussian and prior factorizes across shards. From Scott et al. 2016.

nodes.label: temper_priors()
nodes.rationale: Scales prior widths by sqrt(K) for K-shard Consensus MC. Correct CMC math: each shard sub-posterior must be prior^(1/K) * likelihood(data_k|theta). Widening prior by sqrt(K) is correct; dividing sigma by sqrt(K) was WRONG (multiplied likelihood by K giving K^2 over-weighting).

nodes.label: estimate_contrast_offset_from_data()
nodes.rationale: Physics-informed quantile estimator for initializing contrast/offset priors from C2 data. offset=10th-percentile large-lag region, contrast=90th-percentile small-lag ceiling minus offset. Inputs ravelled so 2D C2 matrices handled correctly. Phase 2 addition.

nodes.label: Bimodal Detection
nodes.rationale: detect_bimodal(): GMM 1-vs-2 component BIC comparison per parameter. delta_BIC > 10 declares bimodality. Two post-conditions: min_weight (minor-mode weight) and min_separation (mode distance in posterior std-devs). Both wired from CMCConfig.

nodes.label: Prior Tempering vs Sigma Scaling
nodes.rationale: CMC shard sub-posteriors must be prior^(1/K) * likelihood(data_k|theta). Widening prior scale by sqrt(K) via temper_priors(priors, K) is correct. Dividing sigma by sqrt(K) (_temper_sigma(), now removed) was wrong: it multiplied likelihood by K per shard giving K^2 over-weighting.

nodes.label: CPU-Only Design
nodes.rationale: All backends assume CPU execution. No GPU backend exists. backend_name='gpu' is not a valid option.

nodes.label: Element-Wise Path for CMC
nodes.rationale: Per-shard NUTS evaluation uses ShardGrid + compute_c2_elementwise() to avoid O(N^2) memory allocation per leapfrog step.

nodes.label: Shard Time-Slice Alignment
nodes.rationale: Each shard's C2 sub-matrix has shape (M,M) where M < N. NumPyro model must be built with t[shard_t_indices] (M time points), not model.t (N points). Mismatch causes shape error at NUTS runtime. t_indices stored in every shard dict; fit_cmc_jax accepts t_override.

nodes.label: Collect Both Extra Fields
nodes.rationale: NUTS must request extra_fields=('energy', 'diverging'). 'energy' for BFMI; 'diverging' for get_divergence_stats(). Requesting only 'energy' silently returns zero divergences regardless of actual NUTS behavior.

nodes.label: Dense Mass Matrix Default
nodes.rationale: 14-param model has three correlated power-law pairs (D0/alpha x2, v0/beta). Diagonal mass matrix cannot navigate cross-correlations and inflates divergences. dense_mass=True is the default.

nodes.label: ArviZ/NumPyro Import Patch
nodes.rationale: az.from_numpyro() accesses numpyro.infer.initialization as a package attribute. Heterodyne's import chain loads the submodule into sys.modules but circular-import timing means the attribute is not always set on the package object. fit_cmc_jax patches this explicitly before calling az.from_numpyro().

nodes.label: Gradient-Safe Floors
nodes.rationale: Uses jnp.where(x > eps, x, eps) instead of jnp.maximum(x, eps) to preserve non-zero gradients for NUTS leapfrog and NLSQ Jacobian. jnp.maximum zeros the gradient below the floor.

nodes.label: No Analytical Integrals
nodes.rationale: Always uses numerical integration (trapezoid_cumsum). Transport coefficient integrals have no closed-form solutions for the general power-law parameterization.

nodes.label: Posterior Contraction Ratio (PCR)
nodes.rationale: PCR = 1 - posterior_std / prior_std. Values near 1.0 = well-constrained; near 0 = prior-dominated; negative = possible misspecification.

nodes.label: NLSQ-to-CMC Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Warm-start pipeline: extract_nlsq_values_for_cmc() -> validate_initial_value_bounds() -> build_init_values_dict() -> build_nlsq_informed_priors() -> transform_nlsq_to_reparam_space(). Resolves NLSQ > prior_mean > default fallback chain.

nodes.rationale: Top-level architecture document for the CMC/NUTS Bayesian subsystem

nodes.label: NLSQ Fitting Architecture
nodes.rationale: Top-level architecture document for the NLSQ warm-start optimization subsystem

nodes.label: classify_fit_quality n_at_bounds parameter
nodes.rationale: New optional parameter n_at_bounds:int=0 added to classify_fit_quality(); demotes chi-squared-good result to 'marginal' when any parameter hits a bound. Phase 3 NL-07 addition.

nodes.label: CMCResult.convergence_status field
nodes.rationale: New homodyne-parity field: string 'converged'|'divergences'|'not_converged'. Populated by merge_shard_cmc_results() and fit_cmc_jax(). Phase 3 CM-07.

nodes.label: CMCResult.warmup_time field
nodes.rationale: New optional field: wall time for warmup phase only. Part of Phase 3 CM-07 homodyne-parity fields.

nodes.label: CMCResult.per_angle_mode field
nodes.rationale: New field: effective per-angle scaling mode, default 'auto'. Phase 3 CM-07 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: CMCResult.chi_squared field
nodes.rationale: New optional field: post-combination chi-squared. Phase 3 CM-07.

nodes.label: CMCResult.quality_flag field
nodes.rationale: New optional field: 'good'|'warning'|'poor'. Phase 3 CM-07 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: CMCResult per-angle contrast/offset fields
nodes.rationale: Four new fields: mean_contrast, std_contrast, mean_offset, std_offset — per-angle posterior statistics. Phase 3 CM-07.

nodes.label: merge_shard_cmc_results hierarchical chunking
nodes.rationale: For K>500 shards, groups into chunks of 500 and combines recursively, bounding peak memory to O(500)*ceil(K/500). Phase 3 CM-09 fix.

nodes.label: GaussNewtonAccumulation dataclass
nodes.rationale: Dataclass holding JtJ, Jtr, chi2, n_points for normal-equation accumulation. Supports + operator for combining partial results from parallel workers.

nodes.label: accumulate_chunks_parallel function
nodes.rationale: Distributes chunk callables across thread pool (gate: n_chunks>=10). Falls back to sequential on OSError/RuntimeError/PicklingError/timeout.

nodes.label: accumulate_chunks_sequential function
nodes.rationale: Sequential fallback for chunk accumulation when n_chunks < 10. Iterates over chunk callables and accumulates into single GaussNewtonAccumulation.

nodes.label: create_ooc_kernels JIT kernel factory
nodes.rationale: Returns two @jax.jit kernels: compute_chunk_accumulators (full Jacobian) and compute_chunk_chi2 (cost probe). Closes over physics constants so JIT compiles once per worker init.

nodes.label: compute_posterior_contraction diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Signature: (CMCResult, dict[str,float]) -> dict[str,float]. Computes PCR=1-posterior_std/prior_std per parameter. Homodyne-parity diagnostic function, pure (no side effects).

nodes.label: compute_nlsq_comparison_metrics diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Signature: (CMCResult, dict|NLSQResult, tolerance_sigma=3.0) -> dict. Returns per-parameter {diff_pct, z_score, status}. Flags parameters exceeding tolerance_sigma (default 3sigma). Pure diagnostic.

nodes.label: compute_precision_analysis diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Signature: (CMCResult, nlsq_result=None) -> dict. Precision loss diagnostics comparing CMC posterior width to NLSQ uncertainty and prior width. Pure diagnostic.

nodes.label: SamplingStats frozen summary dataclass
nodes.rationale: Frozen summary returned by run_nuts_with_retry(). Fields: num_samples, num_warmup, num_divergences, divergence_rate, mean_accept_prob, max_tree_depth_fraction, wall_time_seconds.

nodes.label: SamplingStats.is_healthy property
nodes.rationale: Property returning bool: divergence_rate < 5% AND mean_accept_prob > 0.6. Fast shard-quality gate used by run_nuts_with_retry() to decide whether to retry with reduced step size.

nodes.label: should_use_parallel_accumulation decision helper
nodes.rationale: Returns True when n_chunks >= threshold (default 10). Keeps sequential path for small chunk counts where thread-pool overhead exceeds parallelism benefit.

nodes.label: TimedContext context manager
nodes.rationale: Lightweight context manager: start = perf_counter on enter, elapsed = perf_counter-start on exit. Attached to NLSQResult.wall_time_seconds.

nodes.label: classify_fit_quality / FitQualityValidator
nodes.rationale: Adds bounds-proximity checks (edge_fraction=0.005 of bound span) and stricter chi2 thresholds (chi2_warn=10.0, chi2_fail=100.0) for ValidationReport ERROR/WARNING severity.

nodes.label: jax.block_until_ready in NUTSSampler.run()
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 CM-04 fix: jax.block_until_ready(mcmc.last_state) called immediately after mcmc.run() to force XLA lazy evaluation to complete before timer stops. Without this, wall_time_seconds underestimates true compute time.

nodes.label: Divergence-rate shard filter in fit_cmc_jax
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 CM-02: fit_cmc_jax extracts diverging field from extra_fields and stores divergence_rate in CMCResult.metadata. _combine_shard_posteriors gates on metadata.get('divergence_rate',0.0) <= config.max_divergence_rate (default 10%).

nodes.label: Cross-shard heterogeneity IQR-CV detection
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 CM-03: IQR-CV=(Q75-Q25)/max(|median|,1e-3) per parameter between shard filtering and combination. Raises RuntimeError or logs warning per heterogeneity_abort config field.

nodes.label: robust_consensus_mc combination method wiring
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 CM-01: _combine_shard_posteriors now has dedicated elif branch for robust_consensus_mc with per-parameter z-score outlier detection. scale=max(std,1e-4*(|mean|+1)) prevents near-zero parameter z-score explosions.

nodes.label: SamplingPlan.chain_method field
nodes.rationale: Field propagated through from_config(), for_shard(), AdaptiveSamplingPlan.get_plan(), and retry loop. Values: 'sequential', 'parallel', 'vectorized'. Phase 2 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: ParameterStats hybrid dict/sequence class
nodes.rationale: Hybrid dict/sequence class for CLI and plotting compatibility. Supports dict-style ['D0_ref'], int-index [0], .as_array, and np.asarray() via __array__ protocol. Phase 2 addition.

nodes.label: CMCResult.get_samples_array() method
nodes.rationale: Returns samples as (num_chains, num_samples, n_params). Flat 1D arrays of shape num_chains*num_samples are auto-reshaped. Missing parameters filled with zeros. Phase 2 addition.

nodes.label: CMCResult.get_posterior_stats() method
nodes.rationale: Returns per-parameter dict with mean, std, median, hdi_5%, hdi_95%, r_hat, ess_bulk, ess_tail. Diagnostic fields indexed by position from array-form fields. Phase 2 addition.

nodes.label: check_convergence() high-level helper
nodes.rationale: Returns tuple[str, list[str]]: ('converged'|'divergences'|'not_converged', warnings). 'divergences' takes priority. num_shards parameter scales denominator for CMC. Phase 2 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: create_diagnostics_dict() helper
nodes.rationale: Returns JSON-serializable dict with convergence_status, divergence_rate, max_r_hat, min_ess_bulk, per_parameter, sampling_config, timing. Phase 2 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: log_analysis_summary() helper
nodes.rationale: Logs formatted summary at INFO/ERROR with OK/FAIL indicators. Accepts n_shards and shards_succeeded for CMC multi-shard context. Phase 2 addition.

nodes.label: get_convergence_recommendations() helper
nodes.rationale: Returns list[str] of actionable recommendation strings for high R-hat, low ESS, or high divergence rates. Phase 2 homodyne-parity addition.

nodes.label: CMC io.py full save pipeline
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 homodyne-parity addition: 7 serialization functions including save_samples_npz, load_samples_npz, samples_to_arviz, save_fitted_data_npz, save_parameters_json, save_diagnostics_json, save_all_results. Schema version (1,0).

nodes.label: combination_method dispatch in _combine_shard_posteriors
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 addition: dispatches config.combination_method to consensus_mc (default), simple_average, or robust_consensus_mc. Unknown methods log warning and fall back to consensus_mc.

nodes.label: Bimodal detection min_weight/min_separation postconditions
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 W5 fix: both min_weight and min_separation parameters added to detect_bimodal() and check_shard_bimodality() as postconditions after BIC test. Previously CMCConfig fields were unreachable.

nodes.label: NUTSSampler preflight log-density fix
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 W6 fix: preflight check now uses numpyro.infer.util.log_density(kernel.model,...) which is always callable. Previous approach checked kernel._potential_fn which is None before any sampling run, causing check to always be silently skipped.

nodes.label: parallel_accumulator.py module
nodes.rationale: Module providing Gauss-Newton JtJ accumulation layer used by Out-of-Core and Hybrid Streaming strategies. Contains GaussNewtonAccumulation, accumulate_chunks_parallel, accumulate_chunks_sequential, create_ooc_kernels, should_use_parallel_accumulation.

nodes.label: OutOfCoreStrategy
nodes.rationale: Disk-based JtJ accumulation for memory-limited systems. Uses memory-mapped c2_data and chunk-wise Jacobian rows accumulated into JtJ on disk. Selected for STREAMING memory tier.

nodes.label: HybridStreamingStrategy
nodes.rationale: 4-phase pipeline: normalization, L-BFGS warmup, Gauss-Newton refinement via chunk JtJ accumulation, denormalization+covariance. Falls back to nlsq.curve_fit_large if AdaptiveHybridStreamingOptimizer unavailable.

nodes.label: ModeCluster type
nodes.rationale: Single posterior mode: mean, std, weight, and supporting shard indices. Used in mode-aware bimodal combination.

nodes.label: BimodalConsensusResult type
nodes.rationale: Two-mode combination result: list of ModeCluster objects + consensus mean/std from precision-weighted combination across modes. Populated by cluster_shard_modes() when cross-shard bimodal detection finds distinct mode populations.
